about: Graded relevance judgments, by plugin name, for every query of Queries.json. 2: the plugin does the task; 1: partly, for one region or data source only, or as a side feature. Any plugin not listed is judged not relevant. Judged by Claude (claude-opus-5-5) from each plugin's name, description, about and tags, on 2026-11-12, blind to which system retrieved it: candidates were pooled from the top results of every compared system and language (pool lists below), then completed by a pattern search over the whole catalogue for plugins no system retrieved. A second round judged every plugin shown on the first screen by the keyword forms (each keyword session step, every system), and later rounds did the same for the sentences and keyword lists generated blind by a separate model (each prompt version), so all English runs, sentence and keyword, are fully judged. Review and correct freely; the evaluation reads this file.
